An easier way to find things happening in your city.

We're starting in Chattanooga, TN.

→ Chattanooga, TN

Chattanooga has a full calendar. There is live music nearly every night. There are trails into the mountains and kayaking on the Tennessee River. There are farmers markets, art shows, craft breweries, and coffee shops. Finding all of it used to mean checking five different places.

Things Happening puts it in one place.

We build tools to make discovery simple.

  • Interactive guides with filters for every activity type
  • An events calendar with tags and text search
  • A nearby towns calendar for when you want to venture out
  • Longform guides for those who want more detail
  • Downloadable PDFs for offline use
  • A tags page to browse by activity

We cover all of Chattanooga Downtown, the North Shore, the Southside, Lookout Mountain and nearby cities. Whether you live here or you are visiting, there is something worth doing. We are here to help you find it.
